question: List all measurements from sensor 1.0 in epoch 95.
graph_cypher:
MATCH (s:Sensor {mote_id: 1.0})-[:GENERATED]->(m:Measurement)
MATCH (m)-[:EPOCH_IN]->(e:Epoch {epoch_id: 95})
RETURN coalesce(s.mote_id, m.moteid, m.mote_id) AS mote_id,
       m.time AS time,
       m.temperature AS temperature,
       m.humidity AS humidity,
       m.light AS light,
       m.voltage AS voltage
ORDER BY m.time ASC, s.mote_id ASC
LIMIT 20
